name: Counterspell Primal Magic (Su)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Counterspell exploit

The arcanist can attempt to counter a primal magic event as if counterspelling a magical effect. This requires a Spellcraft check with a DC of 10 + the CR of the primal magic event. If she succeeds, the event is dispelled per dispel magic.
